title: Your About page is losing sales (3 fixes)
caption: "We are passionate about quality." Everyone says that. 3 fixes: a real face, why you started, one specific promise. Plus the prompt that writes it. #branding #shopify #smallbusiness #ecommercetips

beats.headline: Your About page | is *leaking.*
beats.say: Before a stranger buys, they often check one page. Your About page. Is yours *empty?*

beats.headline: Make it *sell*
beats.say: Three fixes turn it into a sales page. And one prompt writes the first *draft.*
beats.box: one prompt writes the first draft.

beats.headline: Everyone says | *that.*
beats.say: [sigh] We are passionate about quality. Everyone says *that.*

beats.headline: The last one | builds *trust.*
beats.say: Three fixes. The last one builds the most *trust.*
Fix one, a real face. *Swap* the stock photo for you. Your photo, your first name, where you work from. A logo can't earn trust. A face *can.*
Fix two, why you started. Three beats. The problem you had, what you tried that failed, and why you built this *instead.*
Fix three, one *promise.* Not we value quality. Something specific. If it breaks within a year, we replace it, free. Only promise what you'll keep.

visual.prompt: Write my About page, under 150 words. Me: [name]. Why I started: [problem]. What failed: [x]. Promise: [y].
reply: Hi, I'm Sam. I started Glowify
So I made one that works.
Our promise: love it or it's free.

beats.say: Then let AI write it. *Feed* it your name, why you started, what failed, and your promise. Ask for under a hundred and fifty words.
Bonus. Add one photo of where you pack orders. A *messy* desk beats a shiny warehouse. [laughter]

beats.label: Fix it tonight
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, fix your About page tonight, and follow for more.
